headline: St. Louis runs Red Bull New York off the park, 3-0
dek: The visitors handed the home side a three-goal defeat at Red Bull Arena on Sept. 30.
body: St. Louis CITY SC traveled to Harrison and left with a commanding 3-0 win over Red Bull New York on September 30. The result puts further distance between the two clubs as the regular season winds toward its close. Two days later in the Pacific Northwest, Seattle Sounders FC edged Sporting Kansas City 2-1 at home, with Albert Rusnák's side now holding 11 assists on the season, tops in the league alongside San Diego FC's Anders Dreyer.

headline: Rossi, Nelson, Deedson out; Žagar and Cunningham in
dek: Three departures clear MLS rosters while two additions bolster Real Salt Lake and Sporting Kansas City.
body: Columbus Crew have transferred forward Diego Rossi to Liga MX side CF Monterrey after 1,290 minutes of first-team action this season. Austin FC's Jayden Nelson, who logged 1,080 minutes in green, moves to Bolton Wanderers of the English Championship. FC Dallas forward Louicius Deedson, 660 minutes played, heads to FC Sochaux-Montbéliard of France's Ligue 2. On the inbound side, Real Salt Lake have acquired 19-year-old Serbian winger Dušan Žagar from FK IMT Belgrade on a U22 Initiative slot. Sporting Kansas City have called up academy-developed defender Alex Cunningham from SKC II on a short-term agreement.

headline: Musa leads at 18; White and Surridge close behind
dek: FC Dallas striker Petar Musa holds a one-goal edge over Vancouver's Brian White with the finish line approaching.
body: Petar Musa of FC Dallas leads the MLS scoring charts with 18 goals. Brian White of Vancouver Whitecaps sits one back at 17, while Nashville SC's Sam Surridge is two off the pace at 16. In the assists race, Seattle Sounders FC's Albert Rusnák and San Diego FC's Anders Dreyer share top spot at 11 apiece, with LAFC's Son Heung-Min one behind at 10. Vancouver's Andrés Cubas dominates the tackles count at an outright 100, 23 clear of second-placed Yannick Bright of Inter Miami CF.

headline: Guilherme beats his xG by 7.3; Almirón trails his by 5.1
dek: Houston's Guilherme and Atlanta's Almirón sit at opposite poles of the league's finishing efficiency table.
body: Houston Dynamo FC's Guilherme leads all overperformers with 14 goals against an xG of 6.7, a positive differential of plus-7.3. New York City FC's Nicolás Fernández is next, scoring 15 against an xG of 8.6 for a plus-6.4 gap. At the other end, Atlanta United FC's Miguel Almirón has scored just 4 goals on an xG of 9.1, a shortfall of minus-5.1. Inter Miami CF's Germán Berterame sits at minus-4.2, with 7 goals against an xG of 11.2.

headline: Columbus, Seattle hold home ground; St. Louis rolls NY
dek: Three results from Sept. 27 through Oct. 2 tighten the playoff picture heading into the final stretch.
body: Columbus Crew beat Inter Miami CF 2-1 on Sept. 27. Three days later, St. Louis CITY SC handed Red Bull New York a 3-0 road victory at Red Bull Arena. Seattle Sounders FC closed the run on Oct. 2, edging Sporting Kansas City 2-1 at Lumen Field. Home sides went 2-1 across the three fixtures, with St. Louis the lone road winner, and a commanding one at that.

headline: Pec, Mora, Gregersen all exit MLS this season
dek: Three established contributors have left the league, with confirmed destinations in Brazil, Mexico, and Sweden.
body: LA Galaxy transferred winger Gabriel Pec to Cruzeiro of Brazil's Série A, ending a stint in which he logged 1,260 minutes this season. Portland Timbers sent forward Felipe Mora to Atlético de San Luis of Liga MX after 1,050 minutes in 2026. Atlanta United defender Stian Gregersen, who accumulated 1,500 minutes this season, moved to Malmö FF of Sweden's top flight. All three transfers were confirmed by the respective clubs.

headline: Musa leads at 18; assist tie at the top
dek: FC Dallas striker Petar Musa holds a one-goal cushion over Brian White with the season nearing its close.
body: Petar Musa of FC Dallas leads the golden boot race with 18 goals. Brian White of Vancouver Whitecaps sits one back at 17, with Sam Surridge of Nashville SC third at 16. In assists, Albert Rusnák of Seattle and Anders Dreyer of San Diego FC are deadlocked at 11 apiece, with Son Heung-Min of LAFC a touch behind at 10. Andrés Cubas of Vancouver dominates the tackles chart at 100, well clear of Yannick Bright at 77 and Silvan Hefti at 64.

headline: Nashville's defense a league apart; Vancouver leads West
dek: Nashville SC's 21 goals allowed is the stingiest mark in MLS as both conferences take shape.
body: Nashville SC leads the East with 60 points on an 18-6-3 record, scoring 55 and conceding just 21, the best defensive record in the league. Vancouver Whitecaps top the West with 50 points at 15-5-6, having scored 59 goals. Inter Miami CF holds the best attack in MLS with 64 goals for, but Nashville's backline remains in a class of its own. Two xG outliers worth noting: Guilherme of Houston is outperforming his xG by plus-7.3, while Miguel Almirón of Atlanta trails his by minus-5.1.

headline: St. Louis stuns New York, Philadelphia rolls Orlando
dek: Fifteen games across Sept. 26-30 produced six draws and a string of road wins that reshuffled the late-season picture.
body: St. Louis CITY SC went to Harrison and beat Red Bull New York 3-0. Philadelphia Union put four past Orlando City at home. Nashville SC blanked Toronto FC 2-0 to protect top spot in the East. CF Montréal beat FC Cincinnati 3-1 and Columbus edged Inter Miami 2-1. In the West, Real Salt Lake dismissed New England 3-0, Seattle rolled past Minnesota 3-1, and San Jose downed Portland 3-1. FC Dallas edged LAFC 1-0. Sporting Kansas City won 2-0 at Houston. LA Galaxy held off Colorado 3-2. Austin, Vancouver, and San Diego all finished level in three separate 3-3 draws.

headline: Union remake backline with McKenzie in, Makhanya out
dek: Philadelphia's center-back corps turned over in a matter of weeks as the club eyes a new defensive foundation.
body: Philadelphia Union have signed defender Mark McKenzie as a Designated Player. The 27-year-old homegrown product arrives from French Ligue 1 side Toulouse FC, with his contract taking effect January 1, 2027. The deal runs through the 2029-30 season, with a club option for 2030-31. The move follows the departure of center back Olwethu Makhanya, who logged 1,170 minutes this season before transferring to Rangers FC of the Scottish Premiership. Charlotte FC winger Kerwin Vargas, who accumulated 1,230 minutes in 2026, has joined Athletico Paranaense of Brazil's Série A on a permanent transfer.

headline: Musa leads the Boot; Rusnák and Dreyer tied at top
dek: FC Dallas's striker holds a one-goal cushion with the regular season winding down.
body: Petar Musa of FC Dallas leads the Golden Boot race with 18 goals, one ahead of Vancouver's Brian White at 17 and Nashville's Sam Surridge at 16. In assists, Albert Rusnák of Seattle and San Diego's Anders Dreyer share the lead at 11, with Son Heung-Min of LAFC one back at 10. The xG table carries a sharp contrast: Guilherme of Houston has scored 14 goals against an xG of 6.7, a positive difference of 7.3, while Atlanta's Miguel Almirón has scored just 4 with an xG of 9.1, sitting 5.1 goals below expectation.

headline: Nashville's defense is the story of the Eastern table
dek: The conference leader has conceded fewer goals than any team in MLS while Inter Miami leads all clubs in scoring.
body: Nashville SC lead the East with 60 points on an 18W-6D-3L record. They have allowed just 21 goals, the best defensive mark in the league. Vancouver Whitecaps top the West at 50 points, 15W-5D-6L, with 59 goals scored and 26 conceded. Inter Miami CF carry the sharpest attack in MLS at 64 goals for, though their xG underperformance, Germán Berterame has scored 7 against an xG of 11.2, points to finishing fragility that could matter in the playoffs.
